summary.case_id: Case 11: Shoulder closure on undivided highway

taper.formula_choice: Speed 55 mph >= 45 mph threshold -> using L = W x S
taper.source: MUTCD 11th Ed. Sec 6B.08, Table 6B-4 (taper length L). Shoulder closures use L/3 per Sec 6B.08 (Table 6B-3).
taper.cdot_reference: CDOT S-630-1 Case 11 (right-shoulder closure, applied to undivided highway)

buffer.lookup_text: MUTCD Table 6B-2: 495 ft (CDOT supplement silent at this speed)
buffer.source: MUTCD 11th Ed. Sec 6B.06, Table 6B-2 (stopping sight distance)

spacing.in_taper_text: 55 mph -> 55 ft spacing (MUTCD Sec 6K.01: spacing equals speed in feet)
spacing.on_tangent_text: 55 mph -> 110 ft spacing (MUTCD Sec 6K.01: spacing equals 2x speed in feet)
spacing.taper_count_text: L/3 = 147 ft / 55 ft max spacing -> 4 drums at 48.9 ft intervals
spacing.tangent_count_text: 50 ft / 110 ft max spacing -> 2 cones at 50.0 ft intervals
spacing.buffer_count_text: Buffer: 495 ft / 110 ft max spacing -> 4 cones at 99.0 ft intervals (CDOT S-630-1 Sheet 2 General Note 18b: tangents along the buffer space)
spacing.downstream_count_text: Downstream taper: 50 ft at ~25 ft spacing -> 2 cones (MUTCD Sec 6B.08: 50-100 ft downstream taper); 2 tangent + 4 buffer + 2 downstream = 8 cones total

case.case: Case 11: Shoulder closure on undivided highway
case.narrative: This scenario follows CDOT Standard Plan S-630-1, Case 11, the general shoulder-work typical (drawn for freeway/expressway), applied to an undivided highway with single-side signing per CDOT S-630-1 Sheet 2 General Note 8.
case.narrative_2: The generated plan follows the same device layout as the reference case with spacing computed for 55 mph.

flagger.source: MUTCD 11th Ed. Chapter 6D (Flagger Control) and Chapter 6E (One-Lane, Two-Way Traffic Control).

violations.message: Work zone (50 ft) is unusually short relative to the required buffer space (495 ft) at 55 mph. Verify this matches the actual job.
